brief: Generates numbers one by one from a start and a step, counting on, repeating between bounds or bouncing between them.
detail: Build one with new stzSequence(name, start, step, mode); the counter lives in the engine under its name, so give each sequence its own name and call Destroy when finished. Modes are 0 (count on without end), 1 (repeat between the bounds set by SetBounds) and 2 (bounce between them). NextValue answers the value it stands on and then moves, so the first call gives the start. Values are whole numbers: a fraction in the start or the step is cut silently.
